description: This file defines functions related to building and managing system prompts for embedded agents, including constructing prompts with various parameters, creating prompt overrides, and applying overrides to sessions.

methods.name: buildEmbeddedSystemPrompt
methods.description: Constructs a system prompt string based on provided parameters for an embedded agent.

methods.name: createSystemPromptOverride
methods.description: Creates a function that overrides the default system prompt with a specified string.

methods.name: applySystemPromptOverrideToSession
methods.description: Applies a prompt override to an agent session, updating its system prompt and related internal properties.
